caption: Fig. 3. pulse Overview. Developers use pulse’s iterator interface (§3) to express pointer traversals, translated to pulse ISA by its dispatch engine (§4.1). During execution, pulse accelerator ensures energy efficiency (§4.2) and in-network design enable distributed traversals (§5).

templates.why_chosen: A thin pipeline where replication is confined to one tier: CPU Node and Memory Node repeat with an ellipsis while the developer layers, network, and accelerator stay singular; every stage carries its own section number.
templates.what_to_learn: Confine an ellipsis-based repeat to exactly one tier of an otherwise thin, single-file pipeline (CPU Node ... Memory Node here), and stamp each stage with the paper's own section number instead of a legend; avoid this figure's overly wide aspect ratio, which compresses every stage into a small strip.
